verification_targets.description: Total X extent of the finished L-bracket (base length 60 mm, measured from X=0 to X=60).
verification_targets.notes: Bounding-box X extent in global coordinates; origin at minimum X/Y/Z corner.

verification_targets.description: Total Y extent of the finished L-bracket (base and arm both 40 mm wide).
verification_targets.notes: Bounding-box Y extent in global coordinates.

verification_targets.description: Total Z extent of the finished L-bracket = BASE_THICKNESS (6) + ARM_HEIGHT (40) = 46 mm, measured from Z=0 bottom face to Z=46 arm top.
verification_targets.notes: ABSOLUTE value: arm height is stated '40 mm tall' ABOVE the 6 mm base, so the QA bounding-box Z must read 46, not 40.

verification_targets.description: Base and vertical arm MUST be fused into exactly one connected solid (one body, no loose parts).
verification_targets.notes: Solid count in the final compound/part must equal 1.

verification_targets.description: Final mesh/solid MUST be a closed manifold (watertight) with no open or non-manifold edges; the two 5 mm through-holes must be closed cylindrical walls.
verification_targets.notes: 1.0 = watertight/valid, 0.0 = leaks. Holes are through-holes so both top and bottom face openings must be capped by the cut's cylindrical wall.

functional_requirements: Base bottom face (Z=0) MUST be a single flat plane so the bracket sits flush on a mounting surface.
The two 5 mm diameter base holes are fastener clearance holes (suitable for M4 screws) for mounting the bracket to a flat surface.

The vertical arm transmits a vertical/in-plane load into the base; the base-to-arm junction is the primary bending region and must remain a continuous solid (a fillet may be added there for strength).
Holes MUST NOT break through into the vertical arm or exit the side faces of the base.
Part is a general-purpose 3D-printed FDM bracket; no tight tolerances required beyond the overall dimensions (±0.5 mm).
special_features: The vertical arm MUST be positioned at the X=0 end of the base: arm occupies X in [ARM_OUTER_FACE_X = 0, ARM_INNER_FACE_X = 6], Y in [0, BASE_WIDTH = 40], Z in [BASE_THICKNESS = 6, TOTAL_HEIGHT = 46]; it MUST NOT be placed anywhere else along the base.

The arm MUST rise upward from the TOP face of the base (Z = BASE_THICKNESS = 6) and MUST be fused (boolean union) with the base so the result is one solid; the arm and base MUST share the face at Z=BASE_THICKNESS.
The arm MUST be full width in Y (ARM_Y_MIN = 0 to ARM_Y_MAX = 40) and MUST NOT be offset or inset from the base sides.

The two mounting holes MUST be through-holes drilled along the Z axis (normal to the base), diameter HOLE_DIAMETER = 5 mm, cutting completely through BASE_THICKNESS = 6 mm — they MUST NOT be blind holes.

Hole centers MUST be at (HOLE_1_X, HOLE_1_Y) = (10, 10) and (HOLE_2_X, HOLE_2_Y) = (50, 30): each hole is HOLE_CENTER_OFFSET_FROM_SHORT_EDGE = 10 mm from a 40 mm short (X) edge and HOLE_CENTER_OFFSET_FROM_LONG_EDGE = 10 mm from a 40 mm long (Y) edge, placed diagonally opposite so the pair is point-symmetric about the base centre (30, 20).
Holes MUST NOT intersect the vertical arm and MUST NOT break out of any base side face; minimum wall between the hole edge (X = 10 - 2.5 = 7.5) and the arm inner face (X = 6) is 1.5 mm.
All outer faces of base and arm MUST be planar and mutually perpendicular (no chamfers, tapers or draft); the only curved geometry is the two cylindrical hole walls.
The outer faces of the arm at X = ARM_OUTER_FACE_X = 0 and the base at X = 0 MUST be coplanar (flush end), forming a clean right-angle L profile in the XZ section.
The part MUST be modelled parametrically from the key_parameters so that BASE_LENGTH, BASE_WIDTH, BASE_THICKNESS, ARM_HEIGHT, ARM_THICKNESS and HOLE_DIAMETER drive all geometry.
cad_brief.user_request_raw: Read the following part request and formal dimension contract. Part request: 'Make an L-shaped bracket with a base 60 mm long, 40 mm wide, and 6 mm thick. The vertical arm is 40 mm tall, 40 mm wide, and 6 mm thick. Include two 5 mm diameter holes in the base, centered 10 mm from the short edges and 10 mm from the long edges.' Formal dimension contract: 'base_length = 60 mm; base_width = 40 mm; base_thickness = 6 mm; arm_height = 40 mm; arm_width = 40 mm; arm_thickness = 6 mm; hole_diameter = 5 mm; hole_center_offset_from_short_edge = 10 mm; hole_center_offset_from_long_edge = 10 mm; hole_count = 2.' Bind the contract to the build123d script you will create. State the formal claim you will verify.

user_request: If any obligation failed, repair the build123d script and re-run the checker until all obligations pass or you can justify why a failure is acceptable. Then package the checked artifact: provide the final bracket.py, check_bracket.py, execution logs, and a short verification report.
